subdivision_of_building: Ground floor change of use and shopfront
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  (08)04 Received: 27 February 2026,  (08)03 Received: 05 February 2026,  (08)02 Received: 05 December 2025,  (01)01, (02)01, (02)03, (02)08, (08)01, (08)07, (08)10 Received: 17 November 2025.  

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - Customers (including takeaway food delivery service cyclists and drivers) shall only be permitted to enter and use the ground floor hot food takeaway and restaurant premises herby permitted between the following hours of 08:00 to 22:00 - Monday to Sunday.  

Reasons:  In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the local acoustic environment in accordance with Local Plan Policy EQ5.  

Note:  If this approved use requires a trading licence from the Council (for example, because the operator intends to sell alcohol or offer entertainment) you should obtain this before you start to trade, note that the Licensing Panel will enquire about and wish you to disclose the terms of this planning permission and will likely align the terms of the licence with those set out here.  

If your licencing application seeks to exceed the opening hours hereby permitted, you will first need to have sought and obtained formally a variation to this condition by submitting a variation of conditions application or planning application.

Condition : 4 - Any residual, food and recyclable waste bins used by the ground floor hot food takeaway and restaurant hereby permitted shall be stored internally within its main kitchen, in the floor area designated in the submitted amended Proposed Ground Floor Plan (08)03 received on 05 February 2026 only, and not be stored or positioned on the public footway at any time apart from for collection purposes no more than four hours prior to and following relevant waste collection dates and times.  No other bins or waste shall be stored or positioned on the public highway network at any other time.  

Reasons:  To protect the appearance and cleanliness of the area, neighbour living conditions and public health and prevent obstruction of the public highway, in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and EC2.
description:
Retrospective application for alterations to the existing ground-floor shopfront; and
Change of use from Sui Generis (hot-food takeaway) to Class E(b) restaurant / café, allowing the preparation and sale of food and drink primarily for consumption on the premises.
